user.title: Configure HAEO dispatch inputs and actuators
user.description: Select HAEO plan sensors and the corresponding real inverter actuators. Dispatch starts disabled.

data.name: Controller name
data.grid_positive_import: Measured grid sensor: positive means import
data.leaf_positive_discharge: Measured Leaf battery sensor: positive means discharge
data.tesla_positive_discharge: Measured Tesla battery sensor: positive means discharge
data.grid_plan: HAEO grid active power (kW, positive import)
data.leaf_plan: HAEO Leaf active power (kW, positive discharge)
data.tesla_plan: HAEO Tesla active power (kW, positive discharge)
data.leaf_actual: Measured Solis/Leaf battery power (W or kW)
data.tesla_actual: Measured Fronius/Tesla battery power (W or kW)

data_descriptions.grid_deadband_w: Return to Self-use when the absolute planned grid power is at or below this value.
data_descriptions.grid_hysteresis_w: Additional watts above the deadband needed to enter Arbitrage. Zero disables hysteresis.

error.invalid_grid_threshold: Enter a finite nonnegative power in watts.
